title: Chapter 53 The Calamity Of The Phoenix Clan
content:
Chapter 53 The Calamity Of The Phoenix Clan

At this time, in the Phoenix Domain.

In the location of the Ice Phoenix Clan, the Grand Elder suddenly rushed out of the hall and looked towards the sky with a serious expression.

"Grand Elder!"

At this time, the clan leader Han Yun came here and said in a panic.

"You also felt it?"

The Grand Elder glanced at Han Yun and said in a calm voice.

Han Yun nodded.

"Grand Elder, what on earth is that existence? Why would my Phoenix Clan provoke such a strong man?"

Han Yun said puzzledly.

Just now, a strong sense of crisis suddenly surged from the bottom of his heart.

At their point, it is normal to be able to sense danger.

And at this time, the danger is approaching.

The gaze is their entire Phoenix Clan.

The Grand Elder stared at the sky and snorted coldly: "No matter who the other party is, if he dares to come to my Phoenix Clan to act wild, he will pay the price."

Their Phoenix Clan is one of the largest clans in the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm.

And they have a very good relationship with the Dragon Clan next door.

The friendship between dragon and phoenix is not just a joke.

Once the phoenix clan is in trouble, the dragon clan will not sit idly by.

At this time, two more figures appeared here.

They were the patriarch and the supreme elder of the fire phoenix clan.

"Who is the other party?"

The supreme elder of the fire phoenix clan said in a deep voice.

Hearing this, the supreme elder of the ice phoenix clan shook his head and said, "I don't know the identity of the other party yet."

Hearing this, the supreme elder of the fire phoenix clan frowned.

His intuition told him that the danger this time was very serious.

Then, he quietly crushed a flame phoenix feather.

And at this moment, a terrifying breath suddenly crushed here from the distant sky.

Just a breath made the four of them change their faces.

"Not good!!"

"Start the clan protection formation!!"

In an instant, they knew that the other party's strength was not something they could deal with.

The terrifying pressure made even the two supreme elders in the heavenly realm feel palpitations.

Soon, a huge and terrifying formation rose from the location of the Ice Phoenix Clan.

At this time, a figure appeared outside the formation.

Looking at the protective formation in front of him, he only punched it out.

Boom!

With a loud bang, the protective formation that had been silent for endless years was directly shattered.

For many years, it has been a long time since the Phoenix Clan opened the protective formation.

You know, opening the protective formation means that the race is in a life-and-death situation.

But now, this protective formation is directly broken.

In the sky, fragments of the formation continued to pour down.

Countless Phoenix Clan members looked at the figure in the void in horror.

The two clan leaders, including the two supreme elders, were already so shocked that they couldn't close their mouths.

Why would their Phoenix Clan provoke such an existence?

They were puzzled.

At this time, the figure had already arrived in front of them.

"Who is the supreme elder of the Phoenix Clan?"

Lu Daosheng said slowly.

The tone was extremely cold, and even carried a hint of murderous intent.

Hearing this, the two supreme elders trembled in their hearts, and then slowly stepped forward.

"This senior, I don't know how my Phoenix Clan offended you, please tell me."

However, Lu Daosheng said coldly: "I'll ask you one last time, who is the supreme elder?"

Seeing this, the two supreme elders looked at each other and said with a stiff face: "Reply to the senior, I am the supreme elder of the Fire Phoenix Clan."

"Senior, I am the supreme elder of the Ice Phoenix Clan."

Two?

Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

Then Lu Daosheng directly took out a wanted order, and it was his daughter on it.

He picked it up on the way here.

Seeing this wanted order, Lu Daosheng's murderous intent could not be suppressed again.

"Who issued this wanted order?"

Lu Daosheng gritted his teeth.

Hearing this, the supreme elder of the Ice Phoenix Clan couldn't help trembling all over.

At this moment, he dared not say a word.

At this time, the Supreme Elder of the Fire Phoenix Clan answered for him.

He pointed at him and said loudly: "Senior, he issued this wanted order, it has nothing to do with me!"

This matter has nothing to do with him.

He only found out about the incident later, and it really has nothing to do with him.

Below, Han Yun's heart was already in turmoil.

He seemed to have known something.

The terrifying existence in front of him was a human, so.

It's over.

Their Phoenix Clan was over.

Han Yun sat down directly on the spot.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's eyes were already looking at the Supreme Elder of the Ice Phoenix Clan.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng directly grabbed him with one hand, and effortlessly grabbed the Supreme Elder of the Ice Phoenix Clan in his hand.

This scene made countless Phoenix Clan members pale.

The Supreme Elder was actually powerless in the hands of the other party.

"Senior, spare me! This is a misunderstanding!!"

The Ice Phoenix Clan's Grand Elder was shocked.

A threat of death kept rising in his heart.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng showed a strange sneer.

"Misunderstanding? You've wanted my daughter for a hundred years, and you tell me it's a misunderstanding?"

As soon as these words came out, the Ice Phoenix Clan's Grand Elder was stunned on the spot.

The terrifying existence in front of him turned out to be the father of the human woman back then. In an instant, the Ice Phoenix Clan's Grand Elder regretted it very much. If he had known this earlier, why did he do it in the first place?

It's a pity that everything is too late.

With a shrill scream, the Ice Phoenix clan's Grand Elder burned up, including his soul.

At this time, Lu Daosheng extracted his soul directly and searched his soul in an extremely cruel way.

Suddenly, the Ice Phoenix clan's Grand Elder screamed even more miserably.

At the same time, Lu Daosheng also learned everything about the other party.

When he learned that the other party wanted to make his daughter the other party's furnace, Lu Daosheng immediately became murderous again.

"Killing you directly is too easy for you."

Lu Daosheng gritted his teeth and said.

Then, Lu Daosheng threw him directly into the world he created.

There, like hell, he will live in endless pain forever.

Watching the Ice Phoenix clan's Grand Elder disappear.

All the Phoenix clan members have begun to pray on the spot.

Han Yun is also the same. They can only pray that the Grand Elder can calm the anger of the terrifying existence in front of them.

However, it was obvious that just punishing the Ice Phoenix Clan's Supreme Elder did not satisfy Lu Daosheng.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked down, his eyes full of murderous intent.

Suddenly, all the Phoenix Clan members turned pale.

But at this moment, a breath suddenly descended on the scene, and then an old voice sounded.

"Your Excellency killed my Ice Phoenix Clan's Supreme Elder, isn't that enough?"

Hearing this voice, the Phoenix Clan members looked puzzled, obviously they didn't recognize him.

But the patriarchs and the Supreme Elders of Hanyun and the Fire Phoenix Clan were overjoyed.

It's the ancestor!

When Lu Daosheng just arrived, the Supreme Elder of the Fire Phoenix Clan awakened the Phoenix Clan's ancestor.

Hearing this voice, Lu Daosheng sneered: "Enough? If my daughter loses a hair, it's not enough to destroy your entire Phoenix Clan."

Such arrogant words made countless Phoenix Clan members look ugly.

After all, their Phoenix Clan is one of the largest clans in the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm. Which member of the clan is not admired by the creatures outside?

But now, someone dares to threaten to destroy their Phoenix Clan.

How can they accept this?

"Do you really want to do this?"

At this time, the voice of the Phoenix Clan ancestor sounded again.

But there was helplessness in his tone.

Looking at the direction of the Phoenix Clan, Lu Daosheng's face was indifferent. He could clearly feel that the other party was just a strong man in the Heavenly King Realm.

As long as he wanted to destroy the entire Phoenix Clan, the other party would be powerless.

But Lu Daosheng was still hesitant in the end.

Because his daughter has the blood of the Ice Phoenix Clan, and his wife, who he had not seen for a long time, is very likely a member of the Ice Phoenix Clan.

But he did not feel the breath of his wife now.

Where is his wife?

And at this moment, a choking voice suddenly sounded from below.

"Brother-in-law!"

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng looked down.

He saw a member of the Ice Phoenix tribe.

"What did you call me?"

Yan Luo wiped her tears and said in a trembling voice: "Yan Lingyun, she is my sister."

Boom!

Lu Daosheng was stunned.

Because Yan Lingyun was the name of his wife.
